body.description: Founded in 1992, Majid Al Futtaim is the leading shopping mall, communities, retail and leisure pioneer across the Middle East, Africa and Asia.

body.name: Carrefour MyCLUB Transfer
body.description: Carrefour S.A. is a French multinational retailer headquartered in Boulogne Billancourt, France, in the Hauts-de-Seine Department near Paris. It is one of the largest hypermarket chains in the world with 12,300 self-service shops at the end of 2016

body.name: Magic Planet
body.description: Magic Planet has an incredible range of fun rides, kids' games and attractions in Dubai. Top Up your card online and enjoy amazing packages.

body.name: VOX Cinemas
body.description: Owned and operated by Majid Al Futtaim Cinemas, VOX Cinemas is the cinema arm of Majid Al Futtaim, the leading shopping mall, retail and leisure pioneer across the Middle East and North Africa. VOX Cinemas is the Middle East’s most innovative and customer-focused exhibitor.

body.name: Mall Of The Emirates
body.description: The Mall of the Emirates, Dubai’s second largest shopping complex after the Dubai Mall, houses 560 international retailers spread over 2,513,017 square feet (233,467 square meters) of retail space.

body.name: City Centre Deira
body.description: City Centres are large-scale, mixed-use shopping destinations, complete with retail stores, restaurants and entertainment facilities. They bring a premium and contemporary experience catering to the needs of tourists, residents and professionals working in the area. Visitors can enjoy a complete lifestyle experience, a one-stop for shopping and outstanding leisure activities in a dynamic environment that lives up to international standards

body.name: My City Center - Al Barsha
body.description: My City Centre from Majid Al Futtaim is a neighborhood retail concept tailored to growing residential communities within the region, providing accessible, convenient shopping and service destinations that addresses the immediate needs of residents through convenience and accessibility.

body.name: Matajer Sharjah
body.description:
Matajer is a neighbourhood shopping centre concept that brings high quality retail brands and services to your community.
The Mall of the Emirates, Dubai’s second largest shopping complex after the Dubai Mall, houses 560 international retailers spread over 2,513,017 square feet (233,467 square meters) of retail space.

body.name: AllSaints
body.description: Worn by British and American celebrities, AllSaints creates design-led clothing and footwear for men and women. With 114 stores in nine countries around the world, the brand offers its consumers a strong attitude and a sense of individuality.

body.name: LuluLemon
body.description: Lululemon is a yoga-inspired athletic apparel company that creates components for people to live long, healthy and fun lives.

body.name: Crate and Barrel
body.description: Crate and Barrel lifestyle with our exclusive collection of home furnishings and housewares classic to contemporary.

body.name: Maisons du Monde
body.description: Maisons du Monde is a French furniture and home decor company founded in Brest in 1990 by Xavier Marie. At the end of 2015, it had nearly 250 stores across France, Italy, Spain, Luxembourg, Belgium, Germany and in Switzerland, of which more than 180 are in France. In 2010, it generated nearly €323 million in sales. in 2015 it employed over 5,500 people.

body.name: Fashion For Less
body.description: Multi branded fashion store housing international fashion brands for men and women at discounted prices. Brands available are: AllSaints, Jane Norman, Peacocks, Lululemon, Halston Heritage, Intropia, Monsoon and Monsoon Kids.

body.name: Ski Dubai
body.description: Ski Dubai is an indoor ski resort with 22,500 square meters of the indoor ski area. The park maintains the temperature of -1 degree Celsius to 2 degrees Celsius throughout the year. It is a part of the Mall of the Emirates, one of the largest shopping malls in the world, located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates

body.name: iFly
body.description: iFLY Dubai is an indoor skydiving experience that makes the controlled human flight a reality.

body.name: Little Explorers
body.description: The home of Time Out Kids Dubai’s “Best Edutainment Centre in Dubai” award for two consecutive years, Little Explorers has proven to be the perfect mix of fun and education for all children from the age of two to seven. A sanctuary where fun, safety and learning are the motto, Little Explorers delivers an environment where your children can acquire knowledge through playing and understanding through exploration.

body.name: Lego
body.description: Founded over 80 years ago, LEGO Group is committed to bringing creative, fun and high quality play experiences to children all over the world. And now this iconic brand can be enjoyed to the fullest via the first LEGO-certified stores in the region in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Kuwait.

body.name: American Girl
body.description: American Girl is a premium brand for girls and division of Mattel, Inc, which encourages the wonder of childhood through an inspiring world of dolls, content, and experiences. The company sells a range of products through its award-winning catalog, and in experiential retail stores.

body.name: Hilton Garden Inn
body.description: Majid Al Futtaim is known for partnering with some of the most established hotel groups, often strategically positioned attached to or in close proximity of its malls. Hilton Garden Inn Dubai Mall of the Emirates is no exception. The new hotel, owned by Majid Al Futtaim and managed by Hilton Worldwide, is the second largest Hilton Garden Inn in the world and the largest outside of America and the first LEED Gold hotel by Majid Al Futtaim in Dubai.

body.name: Aloft CCD
body.description: The hotel features 304 spacious guest rooms and suites – including a region first, four cinema-themed suites inspired from Bollywood, Hollywood, Agent House and a specially created Dubai superhero suite. Rooms also feature a luxurious mix of the brand’s signature offerings, such as an ultra-comfortable plush bed, custom amenities by Bliss® Spa, and SPG Keyless, the industry’s first mobile check-in system where guests can utilize their mobile phones as room keys.

body.name: Sheraton Dubai Mall Of Emirates
body.description: Directly connected to the world-renowned Mall of the Emirates, the Sheraton Dubai, Mall of the Emirates Hotel is a gathering place for corporate travelers, vacationers, and shoppers alike. It is also just a short walk to Mall of the Emirates Metro station, which provides a gateway to the city.

body.name: KEMPINSKI HOTEL MALL OF THE EMIRATES
body.description: empinski Hotels is one of the world’s oldest luxury hotel chains, synonymous with the highest levels of service and style, and the Kempinski Hotel Mall of the Emirates is no exception.  This 48,000 square metre hotel links directly to Majid Al Futtaim’s signature destination mall, Mall of the Emirates.

body.name: IBIS Mall Of Emirates
body.description:
Ibis Dubai Mall of the Emirates is ideally located between the World Trade Centre and Jebel Ali Free Zone, and right next to the renowned Mall of the Emirates shopping destination, where guests can enjoy premium shopping and unique leisure destinations like the Ski Dubai, Magic Planet and VOX Cinemas.

The hotel offers 204 air-conditioned rooms ideal for business and leisure guests with complimentary WIFI, a mini fridge and complimentary tea and coffee. Guests also have access to the adjacent Suite Novotel Mall of the Emirates hotel’s leisure facilities, such as an outdoor pool and fully equipped fitness room.

body.name: NOVOTEL DUBAI DEIRA CITY CENTRE
body.description: Close to Dubai International Airport and key tourist destinations such as the historic Dubai Creek, gold and spice souks, Jumeirah Beach Park and the Dubai Museum, the Novotel City Centre Deira Hotel directly faces the Dubai Metro Station and the iconic City Centre Deira shopping mall.

body.name: IBIS DUBAI CITY CENTRE DEIRA
body.description: The comfortable two-star Ibis Dubai City Centre Deira hotel lies in the heart of the city, minutes away from the Dubai Metro station, the World Trade Center, historic attractions of old Dubai, connected to Novotel City Centre Deira and directly opposite the 370 shops of the City Centre Deira mall.

body.name: PULLMAN CITY CENTRE DEIRA
body.description:
Part of the landmark shopping and leisure destination, the City Centre Deira mall, the Pullman City Centre Deira Hotel is located in the historic heart of old Dubai, and provides easy access to the Dubai Metro.

Each of the hotel’s elegant 317 rooms provides relaxation and entertainment with free WiFi and a widescreen LCD satellite TV.

body.name: IBIS DUBAI AL RIGGA
body.description: Ibis Dubai Al Rigga is located on Al Rigga road in the heart of Deira in Dubai and less than a kilometer from the landmark Clock Tower, next to the Rigga Road Metro station with a few minutes only from Dubai International Airport.

body.name: SUITE NOVOTEL MOE
body.description:
Novotel Suites Dubai Mall of the Emirates is located right in the heart of Dubai, adjacent to Sheikh Zayed Road and next to the renowned Mall of the Emirates shopping destination. 

The hotel also lies a few minutes from major business districts such as Dubai Internet City, Media City and Knowledge Village, as well as popular tourist districts such as the Dubai Marina and the golden sands of Jumeirah Beach.

The hotel offers guests 180 rooms and suites that include a 32" LCD television, Wi-Fi access, a safety box, a minibar and complimentary tea and coffee.
